sources.title: ukr-models/xlm-roberta-base-uk - AI Model Zoo - BimAnt
sources.snippet: The original model has 470M parameters, with 384M of them being input and output embeddings. After shrinking the sentencepiece vocabulary from 250K to 31K (top 25K Ukrainian tokens and top English tokens) the number of model parameters reduced to 134M parameters, and model size reduced from 1GB to 400MB.

sources.title: xlm-roberta-base — Use Cases, Pros & Cons | AI Tools Directory
sources.snippet: XLM-RoBERTa base from Facebook AI, pre-trained on 2.5TB of filtered CommonCrawl text across 100 languages using the RoBERTa training procedure. Enables cross-lingual transfer — models fine-tuned on labeled English data can infer on other languages without parallel annotations.
